exposure: Expression of genes encoding components of EC/EV system (CB1, CB2, TRPV1, MAGL, FAAH, DAGL, NAPE-PLD)
cohort: Human placental samples collected from spontaneous preterm deliveries (at 30 and 34 weeks) and term deliveries (40 weeks).
finding: The term delivery group showed a marked increase in CB1, anandamide, and inflammatory cytokines (mainly TNF-a), along with TRPV1 down-regulation, compared to preterm groups.
cross-section timing: Placental samples were taken at the time of spontaneous delivery (30, 34, and 40 weeks gestation).
